judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with a `sessions` field) instead of the explicitly specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (with `conversations`), and wrong TypeScript interface names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`). It completely omits the required opt-in configuration flag `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` (serving the list unconditionally by default, violating a major security/GDPR requirement of the ticket) as well as `StoreCannotList`. Validation rules also miss the ticket's explicit criteria, allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` when the ticket requires an integer from 1 to 200. Finally, the candidate fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository.
